content: Community sources (CurseForge addon pages, search 2026-10-12): WoW Forever uses Mainline UI architecture and most 12.1.5 APIs; .toc interface 16001; beta addons live in _classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns. ForeverSVBridge (updated 2026-09-24) works around a beta bug where SavedVariables are written at logout but not read at login. WeakAuras team declined to support Mainline Midnight (secret values); Midnight 12.0 added chat messaging lockdown during active encounters. Master loot on Forever still not officially confirmed.
